headline: Recommended approval of Zone Change #3265, city-wide, amending Articles 4, 5, 7 and 9, by a 5-0 vote.
summary: The meeting held a public hearing on Zone Change #3265, which covers the whole city and amends Articles 4, 5, 7 and 9. One person spoke in favor and no one spoke against. Five members voted in favor, none opposed, and the recommendation is to approve.
decisions: Recommended approval of Zone Change #3265 (city-wide, amending Articles 4, 5, 7 and 9) by a 5-0 vote.
